problem.title: Find the Largest Dead-End-Free Subtree in a Binary Search Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree containing positive integers, determine the size of the largest subtree that contains no dead-end nodes.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the BST.
problem.output: • Print the size of the largest dead-end-free subtree.
